_comment: Capability inventory for the digest coverage ledger. One key per LANDSCAPE protocol (must match pr-agent digest.py LANDSCAPE_PROTOCOLS keys). Fields per capability: name (canonical), kind, baseline (true=never nag: foundational OR editorially out of scope for the digest — see the per-capability 'note'), aliases (naming/casing variants to also match), landed (informational), source (immutable-ish ref). Coverage is DERIVED by scanning the digest archive each run (pr-agent/scripts/digest.py check_capability_coverage); there is intentionally NO stored 'covered' flag. Match is case-insensitive substring on name+aliases, so keep names distinctive (generic words like 'authorize'/'settle'/'session' alone would false-match). Cross-protocol alias collisions (e.g. 'split payments' in both MPP and UCP) mark BOTH covered if the digest mentions either — acceptable. Maintain during the landscape refresh against primary sources; baseline-vs-tracked is an editorial call. Spec: pr-agent/intel/COVERAGE-LEDGER-SPEC.md. Seeded x402 2026-06-22; MPP/AP2/ACP/UCP 2026-06-22 from protocols/*.md (verified 2026-06-01). All five protocols re-verified against primary sources 2026-08-18. Backlog triaged 2026-08-25: 5 off-wedge capabilities baselined out (see their 'note'), x402 'upto SVM' alias-fixed (it WAS covered 2026-08-16 as SVM 'upto' payment flow, PR #3094). AP2 and ACP capability sets are unchanged since 2026-06-01 (AP2 has merged nothing since 2026-04-29; ACP has cut no release since 2026-04-17).
